summary: Tested Change Request v1.0 phases 2-8 on PREVIEW, both API and UI. Manager console was not tested, as instructed. Most features work: CAG email restriction (API + inline Register error), ~200-word Trial (198/201 words, 8/9 sentences), Speak toggles to 'Listening…', no 'Mark' buttons anywhere, tables shown as editable grids with numeric cells locked, figures shown on BOTH sides with editable labels, Pro continuous scroll (30 page-breaks, no pager, scroll-progress), Primary/Secondary still paginate (Page 1 of 10 / 1 of 20), Sahayika female mascot and avatars, Sahayika script lines (landing hover, Register focus lines, invalid-form line, pre-round B-T1 line, Ask Sahayika greeting, report 'Well played, QA! Your score is 29 out of a hundred...'), voice-mute switch, metal medals Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum/Purple, and the trial start -> autosave -> submit -> report regression. FOUND 2 BUGS: (1) HIGH: segments are auto-marked reviewed ('Saved' chip + HUD count) as soon as their editor mounts, with no focus and no edit. (2) MEDIUM: the Welcome briefing modal on /how-to-play is not a full-screen overlay. It shows up in the page flow below the content (y=905 on a 1080 viewport).

minor.issue: The Secondary bundle has 9 tables and 21 footnotes but 0 figures (only Pro has 12 figures). The review request said Secondary bundles contain figures.

Write amplification: in Pro, just scrolling to the bottom pushed the attempt version to 583, i.e. hundreds of autosave writes with no user edits (one or more per mounted editor). This is a load risk on the shared Neon DB when many players are online. Same root cause as the auto-done bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Segments are marked done/'Saved' on mount without user interaction. Primary: 9/100 on load, 19/100 after only clicking page ›. Secondary: 10/165 on load. Pro: 37/254 (15%) on load and 128/254 (50%) after only scrolling. API check: every auto-done field is byte-identical to the BHASHINI draft (33 same / 0 different), so the editor fires onUpdate -> onChange with an unchanged value on mount, and onField sets done:true. This defeats the 'review by opening or editing' rule: a player can scroll or page through and reach 100% completion with no review. Fix: in onField only set done when v !== answers[pid].fields[key] (or only emit onChange in TranslationEditor.onUpdate when fromDoc(doc) differs from the last value), and keep onFocus as the second trigger.

The briefing modal ('fixed inset-0 z-[96]') gets computed position:relative because of index.css:124 '.ob-bg > :not(header) { position: relative; z-index: 1 }', and that rule has higher specificity. The modal shows up below the training card (bounding box y=905, h=375 at 1920x1080) instead of as a centred overlay. The page behind is not dimmed or blocked: the training tabs stay clickable while it is 'open', and the step lines stop updating because briefOpen=true. Fix: render the Briefing through a portal (createPortal to document.body), or change the selector to '.ob-bg > :not(header):not(.fixed)'.

issues: The Secondary hover line says 'tables and handnotes'. This should probably be 'headnotes' or 'footnotes' (check the docx script).
The long Varchaspati bubble text (~9 lines) almost fills the hero speech bubble on desktop.
Going back with a tab or Back (go(n) with n<i) does not refresh Sahayika's line while the briefing is open. Minor, and mostly caused by the modal bug.

design_issues.issue_note: Searching 'Delhi' returns 'DG/PD of Audit (Power), New Delhi at Bhopal (Branch Office)' first, and it autofills a Bhopal address. This is data ordering, not a code bug.
issues: Office search ranking puts branch offices first

action_items: HIGH: Stop the auto-mark-done on editor mount. Only mark a segment reviewed on real focus or a real value change. Compare the value before calling at.update(..., done:true) in Round.tsx onField, and suppress no-op onUpdate in TranslationEditor. Then confirm that Primary page 1 load shows 0/100 and Pro load shows 0% reviewed.
MEDIUM: Fix the Briefing modal positioning on /how-to-play (portal, or exclude .fixed from the '.ob-bg > :not(header)' rule), then rebuild the web bundle.
LOW: Fix the 'handnotes' typo in the secondary landing line. Confirm whether Secondary should contain figures (currently 0).
critical_code_review_comments: Round.tsx draftProps.onField always sends done:true, even when TranslationEditor emits its mount-time onUpdate. It also triggers an autosave per segment, which is why the Pro attempt reached version 583 just from scrolling.
index.css '.ob-bg > :not(header)' is a broad rule that silently overrides any position:fixed child (modals, toasts) rendered inside ObBackdrop. Prefer portals for overlays.

Round render takes about 5-6 s, and the first visit after Start Mission sat on 'Loading…' for more than 8 s once. Worth profiling the attempt view and page payload (Pro is about 250 parts plus glossary terms).

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 after test fixes; 1 content note: secondary has no figures)
success_rate.frontend: ~88% (2 of ~17 feature checks failed: auto-done on mount, briefing overlay)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the browser_automation tool. Plant an OTP with /app/scripts/emergent/test-otp.sh <email> <code> immediately before each browser run (codes are single-use), then call page.request.post('/api/auth/otp/verify'). The Round 'Start Mission' button has no data-testid=start on PreRound; use button:has-text('Mission'). The briefing modal opens on every fresh browser context (localStorage hc.briefing.v1). To verify the auto-done fix: start Primary with a fresh @cag.gov.in player, wait 5 s without interaction, and expect '0/100 segments done'. Then page › and expect it to stay at 0. Pro: expect scroll-progress-pct '0% reviewed' after load and after scrolling. /tmp/done_check.py <email> <attemptId> [submit] shows done parts by page. The old iter9 test uses a gmail player that is now blocked (403), so don't run it as-is.
rca of the issue: Auto-done: TranslationEditor's Tiptap onUpdate runs on mount or normalization (the value is unchanged: all auto-done fields equal the BHASHINI draft). It calls props.onChange, so DraftProps.onField -> at.update(pid,{field,done:true}). Repro: start Primary, don't touch anything, and the HUD shows 9/100 with 'Saved' chips on every page-1 segment. Mitigation: guard on value change or on a user-origin transaction. Briefing: index.css:124 '.ob-bg > :not(header){position:relative}' overrides Tailwind .fixed on the Briefing root, because Briefing is a direct child of ObBackdrop (.ob-bg). Repro: open /how-to-play in a fresh browser; the modal sits at the bottom of the page. Mitigation: createPortal, or adjust the selector.
